comment: Seed to Shelf teaser: short open → field → packhouse → dispatch → close, with burned-in captions. Same scene modules as vo_script.impact.json (the outcome lines l3/b3, k2 and the open's x5 are dropped; the scenes fall back to on-screen text). Build with CUT=impact-teaser.

lines.text: A seedling that never comes up.
A harvest that misses the order.
A crate at the wrong store.
Impact isn't a promise. It's measured.
lines.tts: Impact isn't a promise... It's measured.

lines.text: Here are three, from one grower's season.
In the field, a camera on the tractor measures every lettuce.
The model forecasts the boxes ready each day, and matches them to the orders.
The indicator: boxes not wasted, times their cost, plus shortfalls avoided, times the penalty.
lines.tts: The indicator... boxes not wasted, times their cost, plus shortfalls avoided, times the penalty.

lines.text: In the packhouse, every pumpkin is counted and graded for quality, with no hand counts.
The indicator: hours saved, times cost per hour, plus kilos graded right, times the price difference.
lines.tts: The indicator... hours saved, times cost per hour, plus kilos graded right, times the price difference.

lines.text: At dispatch, one crate at the wrong supermarket means a rejection, and a fine.
AI recognizes each crate, checks the order, labels it, and holds back any mismatch.
The indicator: rejections avoided, times the fine, plus the product, plus the freight.
lines.tts: The indicator... rejections avoided, times the fine, plus the product, plus the freight.

lines.text: Six problems. Six indicators. One season.
lines.tts: Six problems... Six indicators... One season.

lines.text: Because AI is only worth building when you can measure what it gives back.
